title: Complete Factorization of Special Integers
statement: Theorem 5.3 reduces complete factorization of special integers to amplified squarefree-part-or-prime extraction; Corollary 5.4 instantiates it quantumly.

target.description: $N=\prod_i p_i^{\alpha_i}$ with distinct primes and pairwise-distinct positive exponents $\alpha_i$ (Definition 5.1).

parameters.name: N
parameters.domain: Positive integer with pairwise-distinct prime exponents.

parameters.name: T
parameters.domain: $T=\omega(\log N)$; polynomially bounded choices give polynomial overhead.

assumptions: Each amplified subroutine returns the squarefree part or a prime divisor with probability $1-\exp(-\Omega(T))$ on every required subinput.
The class does not contain ordinary RSA moduli $pq$ with two distinct primes, since both exponents are 1.

time.note: No total bound is extracted for this coordinate in the checked result.

memory.note: No total classical/quantum memory bound is extracted for this result.

classical_time.note: Classical work outside amplified subroutine calls in Theorem 5.3.

oracle_calls.note: Calls to the algorithm of Lemma 5.2, each using up to T base calls; this is not O(sqrt(log N)) elementary quantum circuit calls.

quantum_calls.note: Composition of Lemma 5.2 and Theorem 5.3. With T=omega(log N), Corollary 5.4 states omega((log N)^(3/2)) calls; that omega is not rewritten as big-O.

success.description: Theorem 5.3 and Corollary 5.4 guarantee full factorization for special inputs with amplification parameter T=omega(log N).

review.scope: Checked the stated event and bound in the cited theorem/corollary and its surrounding argument; not a proof reproduction.

evidence.locator: PDF pp. 33–36 / printed pp. 31–34, Definition 5.1, Lemma 5.2, Theorem 5.3, Algorithm 5.1 and Corollary 5.4.
evidence.interpretation: Targeted transcription of this result's input, output, cost accounting and success event; not a full-paper audit.

limitations: Restricted inputs, not a full-factorization algorithm for general RSA semiprimes.
Standalone Jacobi-symbol gate, depth and space optimizations in Section 4 are excluded.
The reduction's amplified subroutine calls and underlying circuit invocations are separate resource coordinates.
